html:
Office Order – Termination of Services

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.nowdate(), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

{% set disciplinary_case = frappe.get_doc("Disciplinary Case", doc.case_id) %} {% set employee_doc = frappe.get_doc("Employee", disciplinary_case.employee_id) %} {% set enquiry_list = frappe.get_list( "Domestic Enquiry", filters={"case_id": doc.case_id}, fields=["name"], limit=1 ) %} {% if enquiry_list %} {% set enquiry_doc = frappe.get_doc("Domestic Enquiry", enquiry_list[0].name) %} {% else %} {% set enquiry_doc = None %} {% endif %}

Employee Name: {{ doc.employee_name }}

Employee ID: {{ doc.employee_id }}

Designation: {{ doc.designation }}

Branch Name: {{ doc.branch_name }}

Whereas you were provided employment by Sahayog Multistate Credit Co-operative Society Ltd., as per the terms and conditions of employment specifically provided in the appointment letter dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(employee_doc.date_of_joining, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}.

{% if enquiry_doc %}

It has been reported that due care was not taken by you while discharging your job responsibilities. An allegation of {{ doc.issue_in_details }} was made. Show Cause Notice was issued to you on {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_reported_to_hr, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} and Notice of Enquiry was issued on {{ frappe.utils.format_date(enquiry_doc.date_of_enquiry, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}.

{% endif %}
{% if enquiry_doc %}

During the investigations and internal enquiry, {{ enquiry_doc.remarks }} was observed which constitutes serious violation. After going through all available facts and circumstances, it has been established that you committed the violation with ulterior intention, which is serious misconduct. Due to the same, the Company has lost trust and confidence in you.

As a result, a penalty of Dismissal from the services of the Company is imposed as per company policy and you are removed from services with immediate effect. You are asked to hand over all company property provided to you to the concerned authorized official and contact HR for your full and final settlement. You are not entitled to any terminal benefits other than PF and the Company reserves the right to take legal action for recovering any balance amount.

{% else %}

Domestic Enquiry data not found for this case. Please check linked enquiry.

{% endif %}

For Sahayog Multistate Credit Cooperative Society Ltd.

Authorized Signatory
